task: round 20 scan_hyp_private_view: private view of the cap direction (public +0.002 from cap 6) and the 29 Sep finals recommendation among {best cap-family file, #37, #38, exp70b}, with P(bronze)/P(silver) per pair; new testable ideas

findings.what:
PRIVATE VIEW OF THE CAP-6 STEP. C = the private score of exp70g minus that of #37. This is a model with judgmental inputs, not a measurement.
PUBLIC READ. The +0.002 public display is about one net true public division event: either ~1 TP with 0-1 FP, or 2 TP with ~2 FP. That fits ~44 extra public insertions (29% of ~150) at a ~5% scorable share. The insertion rate is 1.5 per clip: +6 forks on the 4 dummy clips, 85 on the 56 lab clips.
PRIVATE ARITHMETIC. The private part (71%) should get ~105-170 extra insertions. About lam ~ 5 of them are scorable (range 2-10). That count scales with the private annotation density: 44b6-like 0.8% vs 6bba-like 5.2% of predicted nodes.
- One private TP is worth ~ +0.1/Den_priv ~ +0.0009. Here Den_priv ~105, i.e. 2.4 x the public ~44; one public TP is ~ +0.0023.
- One private FP costs ~ -J/Den ~ -0.0003.
- Break-even marginal precision J/(1+J) ~ 0.17-0.29.
MARGINAL PRECISION q. These are the 5th-6th insertions per clip; their DaughterNet score median is 0.505 vs 0.587 for the cap-4 set. Two hypotheses:
- PUBLIC-LIKE (the private embryos behave like the public one): q ~ Beta(3,4), mean 0.43. Then E[C] ~ 5 x (0.43 x 0.0009 - 0.57 x 0.0003) ~ +0.0011.
- LAB-LIKE (they behave like 44b6/6bba): q ~ Beta(1.5,7), mean 0.18. Then E[C] ~ 5 x (0.18 x 0.0009 - 0.82 x 0.0003) ~ -0.0004. Basis: the lab marginal went 0 TP / 4 FP at cap 6 and 1 TP / 5 FP from cap 4 to 8, even IN-SAMPLE; OOF all-insertion precision was 4/15.
MC RESULT, with weight 0.45 on public-like:
- C mean ~ +0.0004 (-0.00046 lab-only .. +0.0009 at weight 0.7).
- sd ~ 0.0017-0.0023 (~0.001 if the private Den is twice as large).
- P(C > 0) ~ 0.5 (0.32-0.59).
So the public +0.002 transfers to roughly +0.0004 +- 0.002 on private. The sign is about a coin flip, and the spread is wider than the insertion itself (I ~ N(0.6, 0.8)e-3).
REFUTED PRIOR. Round 15's R15DS-7 priced cap 6 on public at EV -0.001..-0.002 with P(+1 TP) < 0.15; probe 45 refutes it. This is the second division knob where the lab and the public disagree in sign (after dc0.30). Both times the public embryo held more recoverable true divisions than the train embryos.

findings.what:
P(MEDAL) PER FINALS PAIR. This is the round-16 MC, re-based on the 19:43Z LB:
- 3,956 teams: >=0.960 86, 0.955-0.959 199, 0.954 115, 0.953 404;
- growth over the remaining 52 h gives N_final ~4,008, so bronze ~#400 and silver ~#200;
- C from r20pv-1 is the only new term.
Values are P(bronze+)/P(silver+) for the base mix. Brackets give the range over 10 scenarios: public-like weight 0/.2/.45/.7, three fields, pessimistic insertion, C at half scale, stalled field growth.
- (A) {#37,#38}, ticked now: .53/.12 [.34-.85 / .04-.41].
- (B) {exp70b,#38}: .54/.16 [.38-.84 / .07-.44].
- (P1) {exp70g,#37}: .67/.38 [.51-.84 / .20-.60].
- (P2) {exp70g,#38}: .52/.35 [.34-.75 / .16-.48].
- (P3) {exp70g,exp70b}: .69/.40 [.54-.85 / .23-.62].
- (P4/P5) {exp76e,#37} and {exp76e,exp70b}: ~.68/.39-.40, equal to P3 within noise.
- (P6) {exp78a cap 8,#37}: .68/.41 [.50-.84 / .21-.61]. It matters only if cap 8 out-displays cap 6.
- (P7) two cap files, e.g. {exp78a,exp70g}: .57/.42 [.38-.66 / .20-.54]. Dominated.
ROBUST ORDER.
- P1 - A = +0.06..+0.21 bronze and +0.08..+0.33 silver in every scenario. That includes the fully lab-adverse one (public-like weight 0: C mean -0.00046, P(C<0) 0.68), where P1 is .60/.25 vs A .52/.12.
- The one exception is a stalled field (growth r 0-0.2): bronze ties (-0.01..+0.004), and silver still gains +0.12..+0.19.
- P2 < P1 in every scenario (-0.09..-0.22 bronze).
- P3 - P1 = 0..+0.03. That rests on the fm45 prior N(0.05, 0.3-0.6)e-3 and is inside model error.
MECHANISM (model-light).
- The cap file is nested on its partner, so {cap, #37} = X + I + max(C, 0).
- #38 buys only the X floor. X's own private rank is modelled at ~540 (p10-p90 470-610; P(inside bronze) ~0.01), so that floor has no medal value unless the field stops growing.
- {cap, #38} throws away I exactly in the C < 0 worlds.
- Two cap files keep no floor against the cap direction (cliff P(best < X) 0.34-0.52).
COST OF THE HIGHER VARIANCE. P(best final below X) rises from ~0.09-0.12 for A to 0.16-0.28 for P1. That changes the rank, not the medal.

findings.what:
PRIVATE COST OF FURTHER CAP DOSES (exp78a cap 8, exp78b cap 12 + FRAME_CAP 2, exp70q thr 0.3).
- Each step adds lower-ranked DaughterNet candidates. The lab cap-8 extras over cap 6 went 1 TP / 1 FP in-sample; there is no lab for thr 0.3 or FRAME_CAP 2.
- So q falls with the dose while the scorable count rises, and the private mean of each extra step is <= that of cap 6.
- With a nested no-cap partner (#37/exp70b), extra variance does not hurt the medal. In the base mix P6 ~ P1 on bronze and +0.01-0.05 on silver; in adverse worlds it is lower.
- The public display is the only evidence per dose, so a higher dose becomes the final only on a strictly higher display (r20pv-3).
- exp78b changes two knobs and the per-frame steal pattern at once. If it out-displays the others, its private caveat must say 'two knobs, no lab'.

findings.what:
HONEST ANSWER: no new mechanism reaches R8. The 27 Sep 12:00Z cutoff has passed, and public division rungs now run only under the user's aggressive-mode directives. This scan proposes no new build.
Rejected in this focus, with reasons:
(1) A density- or score-gated cap (cap 6 only where the 5th-6th candidates have p >= 0.5): a new knob with no lab. It would likely give back the public TP, and in a nested pair variance reduction has no medal value.
(2) A twin + cap6 file (no insertion, cap 6): meaningless, because cap acts only through the insertion.
(3) A {cap, #38} pairing: dominated (r20pv-2).
(4) An OOF cap lab: no decision value (r20pv-5).
(5) Closed families, not re-proposed: overlap consensus, forkmid replication, K3b, forkblob, ANTIPAR, DNVETO, K4, gap, z-split, headroom, swapfix, stitch, leaf prune, float, edge filter, head retrain, DC rungs.
